sentences.text: EBRD 最初聚焦前东方集团国家，后扩展至从中欧到中亚的30多个国家。
sentences.evidence: Initially focused on the countries of the former Eastern Bloc, it expanded to support development in more than 30 countries from Central Europe to Central Asia.

sentences.text: EBRD 由77个国家、欧盟和欧洲投资银行共同拥有。
sentences.evidence: The EBRD is owned by 77 countries, the European Union and the European Investment Bank.

sentences.text: EBRD 最大的单一股东是美国。
sentences.evidence: with the biggest single shareholder being the United States

sentences.text: 设立该行的协定于1990年5月29日由40个国家等签署。
sentences.evidence: signed on 29 May 1990 by actors such as 40 states
